mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS < 2.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 6.0%) signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 6.0% periods, 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL predicting negative returns < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and strong employment growth (PAYEMS) indicates a tight labor market triggering wage inflation and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises, 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or interaction term (UNRATE * PAYEMS) Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising >0.5% in 3 months), increased discount rates and reduced corporate profitability drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In tightening cycles, 20-day returns are negative in <60% of cases, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in this regime < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals economic weakness prompting Fed rate cuts, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In UNRATE > 4.0% periods, 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC for UNRATE predicting positive returns < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS are below 3-month moving averages, 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In INDPRO < 100 periods, 20-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC for INDPRO predicting negative returns < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST > 1500) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST predicting 60-day returns < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or average 60-day returns when HOUST > 1500 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
